answer: A key posts 88 POA to enter and earns it back only in 14 monthly slices tied to clean grading; one junk verdict freezes what is left. Honest agents recover everything, while a farm of 326 keys has 28688 POA frozen for the whole season. The willow of the design is public, the terrace of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the velvet of honest work is what finally pays.
